poc_plan: Phase 1 (days 1-3): smoke tests, integrate streaming SDK, validate function/tool calling flow
Phase 2 (days 4-9): load tests — ramp to 150-250 concurrent streaming sessions across two regions; include tool-calls to internal search (latency measured)
Phase 3 (days 10-12): chaos scenarios — forced reconnects, token loss, KV-cache resume, verify idempotency
Phase 4 (days 13-14): cost analysis and handoff — generate per-tenant token/latency report; discuss Dedicated sizing and pricing
poc_success_criteria: First-token streaming latency median < 200ms, p95 < 400ms under target concurrent load
End-to-end tool-calling (request -> tool -> response) median < 500ms, p95 < 800ms
No more than 0.5% message loss on reconnects; resumed sessions preserve KV context for >=10 turns
Per-tenant quota controls demonstrated: ability to enforce monthly token caps and per-minute RPS with burst windows
Operational telemetry: dashboards show per-tenant token counts, cost breakdown, top 5 slow routes
use_case_summary: Platform: multi-tenant agent orchestration used by SMB and mid-market customers. Primary flow is streaming chat with tool calling (search, CRM lookups, small SQL queries). Key requirements: predictable streaming latency (first-token under ~200-300ms), robust reconnect/resume, per-tenant quotas and billing visibility, and compliance hooks (KMS + residency). Starting on Hosted API for speed of integration; Dedicated considered for committed capacity, VPC/KMS, and deterministic latency at scale.
